name: Census Bureau
tagline: US Census Bureau open data APIs for demographic, economic, and geographic statistics
description: The U.S. Census Bureau provides free public REST APIs for official American demographic, economic, and geographic statistics. Developers query ACS, Decennial Census, Economic Census, Population Estimates, and related datasets with variables, geographies, and optional API keys for higher rate limits.

auth.details: Optional API key as query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY. Key required for higher rate limits; signup at api.census.gov. Without a key, limited to 500 queries per IP per day.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free with optional API key; 500 queries/IP/day without key, higher with registered key

rate_limits: 500 queries per IP address per day without an API key; with a key, higher limits (see docs)
use_cases: get ACS population estimates by state or county
query Decennial Census demographic variables for a geography
look up economic indicators from Economic Census datasets
fetch population estimates time series for US regions
resolve geographic FIPS codes and area names for census geographies
